params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a small real-life interior. SETTING: the tiny second-floor home of a poor family in an old red-brick multi-family villa under the Seoul fortress wall, 6:50 am on a spring school day. One small living room that is also kitchen and bedroom, about 6 by 5 meters, ceiling 2.4 m: warm yellow vinyl floor (jangpan) with an electric heating mat and a folded blanket; cream floral wallpaper slightly faded; a round foldable low wooden dining table (jwasik bapsang) in the middle with breakfast dishes; a small girl of ten in a lilac sweatshirt sits on a floor cushion at the table, her long black hair half-braided; behind her the player character kneels in a black school blazer braiding her hair with both hands; a child's small study desk with a desk lamp and school bag; a metal clothes hanger rack with school uniforms; a small kitchenette along one wall (two-burner stove, small fridge, rice cooker); a framed photo of a smiling man in a white safety helmet on the wall with an old worn hammer hung next to it; an aluminium sliding window with security bars showing the grey granite fortress wall and pine trees in cool morning light. Soft clean morning light, cozy but cramped. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, frames, furniture and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, tile seams, wood grain lines). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in lived-in props. CAMERA: third-person game camera, lens height about 1.6 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective, the whole room readable. The reference image shows the player character (a lanky 17-year-old Korean boy with curly black hair): draw him small, standing in the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. Posters, boards, menus and labels are simple blocks of color or tiny illegible scribbles: absolutely no readable letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
